description: Sets the order of the photos and videos inside one project. Use it to choose which photos lead a project page (the cover is set with update_project). Pass item ids in the new order (from list_projects with project; library video ids work too); ones you leave out keep their current order after them.

itemIds.description: Item ids in their new order, e.g. ["0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"].

project.description: The project (slug, title, or id), e.g. "arched-entry-two-story".

showcaseId.description: Projects showcase id from list_showcases, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: reorder_project_items
title: Reorder project items
